positive/.env:3:1  warning  EG006 duplicate-key  API_URL is defined 3 times in positive/.env (lines 1, 3 and 4)
  variable: API_URL
  evidence: line 1: http://localhost:3000; line 3: http://localhost:4000; line 4: http://localhost:3000
  why: Most loaders (dotenv, python-dotenv, Docker) silently use the last definition, so editing the first one has no effect and the file says two different things.
  fix: Keep one definition of API_URL in positive/.env: delete line 3 or the earlier one at line 1, keeping the value you intend.
  related: positive/.env:1:1
  related: positive/.env:4:1
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG006-duplicate-key.md
